GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091.112 (11 Oct 45) GB
(SCAPIN-123)
APO 500
12 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Protection of Allied and Axis Property.
1. Reference letter this headquarters, file AG 091.112 (13 Sept 45) MG, subject as above; you are advised that in the execution of paragraph 2, your agencies will permit the Governments, or any national of any of the United Nations, to submit repots direct to this headquarters if they so desire.
2. Acknowledgement of this directive is desired.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H.W. Allen
/t/ H.W. ALLEN
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
